<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2DsBzZu2upUckxWhTEYCcSG)_

Docs only: `docs/architecture/citation-matching-from-selection.org`.

- Fuzzy matching of a selected citation (Chicago/APA/IEEE or a full bibliography entry) against BibTeX and DEVONthink records, with weights and thresholds.
- Getting the selection from Highlights and DEVONthink to Emacs with a hotkey/Service and org-protocol (no overlay).
- A generated "Cited works" end section in the litnote that replaces the removed `print_bibliography` block and shows which works already have litnotes.
- Not implemented; includes a PR order and open questions.

No CHANGELOG edits.

---
